work.title: Untitled (Games and Targets)
work.description: Dense mixed-media collage surrounds a central white paper inset bearing pencil-drawn warplane silhouettes. Borders are populated with bullseye targets, chess pieces, soccer balls, an American football, compact discs, and chess-piece forms against a yellow, red, and black ground.
work.composition: central white inset flanked by dense borders
